company.name: Vividion Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Vividion is a developer of a novel drug discovery platform designed to offer transformative treatments to patients with serious illnesses.
company.description: Vividion is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapeutics that treat major unmet clinical needs using the first platform for proteome-wide drug and target discovery. Making accessible the broad set of proteins expressed in human cells, the company’s platform was spun out of the labs of Vividion’s scientific founders, a team of experts in chemical biology and synthetic chemistry from The Scripps Research Institute in La Jolla, CA.  Vividion is committed to advancing and applying its pioneering synthetic and proteomic chemistry platforms to create therapeutics that will make a transformative difference in patients.

productsAndServices.description: A proprietary platform that uses covalent chemistry and mass spectrometry to identify druggable protein pockets across the human proteome for small molecule drug discovery.
productsAndServices.name: Chemoproteomics Platform

productsAndServices.description: A clinical-stage covalent inhibitor targeting Werner helicase (WRN) for treatment of solid tumors with high microsatellite instability (MSI).
productsAndServices.name: VVD-214 (WRN Inhibitor)

productsAndServices.description: An oral small molecule inhibitor targeting the interaction between RAS and PI3Kα proteins for treatment of advanced solid tumors.
productsAndServices.name: RAS-PI3Kα Inhibitor

productsAndServices.description: An oral small molecule designed to activate KEAP1 protein, under clinical evaluation for solid tumors.
productsAndServices.name: Oral KEAP1 Activator

productsAndServices.description: An oral small molecule inhibitor targeting STAT3 protein, in clinical trials for solid and hematologic malignancies.
productsAndServices.name: Oral STAT3 Inhibitor

aiResearchSummary.text: Vividion Therapeutics is researching compounds and methods for activating Nrf2 by inhibiting KEAP1, as described in Keap1 inhibitors and uses thereof, and for inhibiting STAT3, as detailed in Compounds and methods for modulating stat3. Their work also includes compounds and methods for modulating RAS-PI3K, and selective JAK1 compounds and their uses. These efforts focus on developing novel drug discovery approaches targeting key disease-related pathways.
